title: 4A Lined Sticky Notes, 5 x 8 Inches, Pastel Yellow, 4 Pads, 50 Sheets per Pad, 200 Sheets Total (2 Packs of 2)
bullets: 4 pads, 200 sheets total: Your order contains 2 wrapped twin-packs. Each twin-pack holds 2 stacked pads with 50 sheets per pad; open the outer wrap to separate the pads.
Large 5 x 8 inch lined pages: A roomy writing area for meeting notes, shopping lists, study summaries and daily tasks. Printed lines help keep longer notes organized.
Pastel yellow paper: A light yellow background with ruled lines. This is the pastel yellow option; bright assorted-color versions are separate choices.
Self-stick note sheets: Write on a supported surface, peel off one sheet and place your reminder where needed. Apply to a clean, dry, smooth surface and test delicate finishes first.
For work, home and study: Use the large lined sheets for checklists, project steps and household planning. Includes paper pads only; pens, boards and other scene accessories are not included.
